name: Titus' Lasioglossum
desc: Titus' Lasioglossum (Lasioglossum titusi): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 848 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lasioglossum titusi is a species of sweat bee in the family Halictidae. It is a solitary bee that nests in the soil, often in flat, bare ground.
